Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail

Class MailConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail.MailConfiguration
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties(MailProperties.class) public class MailConfiguration extends Object
Wires the SMTP implementation of AccountMailer. The message source is private to the mailer, so it never competes with the application's own MessageSource bean.

    • emailOttDelivery

      @Bean public OttDelivery emailOttDelivery(org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender mailSender, MailProperties properties)
      Creates the e-mail one-time token delivery. Its Thymeleaf engine is built here and deliberately not exposed as a bean, because a TemplateEngine bean would replace the one of the web pages.
      Parameters:
      mailSender - Spring Mail sender configured by spring.mail.*.
      properties - sender, base URL and locale.
      Returns:
      the e-mail delivery of one-time tokens.
